ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

3. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

6. D — newton (N)

7. B — 100 °C

8. D — Producers

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

10. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
